response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior engineer with deep experience in D, TypeScript/Node.js, and web/full-stack systems, plus some relevant geospatial exposure through GISCollective, but he lacks current, substantial C++ or Rust experience (his only significant C/C++ work was NI LabWindows/CVI over a decade ago) and has no demonstrated background in routing, navigation guidance systems, or large-scale distributed pipeline engineering as required by this role.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level engineering experience across many domains and languages
Direct geospatial/GIS platform experience via GISCollective (event-driven Geo-Data platform)
Strong track record of building distributed, high-performance systems (e.g., low-latency D services at Sociomantic) and DevOps/CI infrastructure
concerns: No recent or deep C++/Rust experience; primary C++ work was over 10 years ago in a niche IDE context
No evidence of routing/navigation-specific engineering or real-time traffic data integration
Current role (re:cinq) and most recent years are focused on TypeScript/full-stack/AI tooling, diverging from the systems-level C++/Rust focus required
